restaurantName: Du Shi Li De Xiang Cun
address: 26-1 Qingyun Alley, Gulou, Nanjing, China Mainland
bio: This unassuming-looking joint in a residential building has been in operation for over 20 years and locals are hooked on the home-style Jiangzhe dishes. With about 40 items on the menu, it's all killer, no filler. Top picks include ruan dou rice paddy eel served in a sizzling pot – incredible wok hei marries scallion aromas, deep umami and peppery warmth. The brine-poached pork intestine features bouncy meat on a bed of shredded tofu skin....
pageTitle: Du Shi Li De Xiang Cun
